# 模拟器自检的截图清单。
#
# 一行一张：「名字 启动参数…」。名字用 01-xx 这样的前缀，发布里就按这个顺序排。
#
# 为什么单独放一个文件：以前这份清单写死在 workflow 里，
# 每加一个界面就要改 workflow，而改 workflow 会牵扯到 GITHUB_TOKEN 的
# workflows 权限（CI 里那个「回提交源码」的步骤因此挂过一次）。
# 挪出来之后，加界面只要推这个几百字节的小文件。
#
# 可用的启动开关（DemoSeed 里实现，只在 Debug 生效）：
#   -aevisDemo              写入演示数据
#   -aevisOpenSettings      直接打开设置面板
#   -aevisSettingsFocus=xx  只显示某一张设置卡（设置页太长，一屏截不全）
#   -aevisNoGlass / -aevisSimple / -aevisCustomBackground
#   -aevisOpenMoments / -aevisOpenTogether / -aevisOpenMemoryList
#   -aevisSelfCheck         自检页

01-onboarding
02-chat        -aevisDemo
03-noglass     -aevisDemo -aevisNoGlass
04-simple      -aevisDemo -aevisSimple
05-paper       -aevisDemo -aevisCustomBackground

# 设置页太长一屏截不全 —— -aevisSettingsFocus 每次只显示一张卡
06-bubbles     -aevisDemo -aevisOpenSettings -aevisSettingsFocus=bubbles
07-memory      -aevisDemo -aevisOpenSettings -aevisSettingsFocus=memory
08-myprofile   -aevisDemo -aevisOpenSettings -aevisSettingsFocus=myprofile
09-model       -aevisDemo -aevisOpenSettings -aevisSettingsFocus=model
10-memory-list -aevisDemo -aevisOpenSettings -aevisSettingsFocus=memory -aevisOpenMemoryList
11-moments     -aevisDemo -aevisOpenMoments
12-moments-set -aevisDemo -aevisOpenSettings -aevisSettingsFocus=moments
13-together    -aevisDemo -aevisOpenTogether
14-companion   -aevisDemo -aevisOpenSettings -aevisSettingsFocus=companion
15-douyin      -aevisDemo -aevisOpenSettings -aevisSettingsFocus=douyin
16-system      -aevisDemo -aevisOpenSettings -aevisSettingsFocus=system
17-music       -aevisDemo -aevisOpenSettings -aevisSettingsFocus=music
18-emoji       -aevisDemo -aevisOpenSettings -aevisSettingsFocus=emoji
19-mcp         -aevisDemo -aevisOpenSettings -aevisSettingsFocus=mcp
20-selfcheck   -aevisSelfCheck
